title: Mind the Gap: A Practical Guide for Effectively Addressing Missing Data in Moderation Analysis
titleZh: 正视缺失：有效处理调节分析中缺失数据的实用指南
abstract: Advances in methodology and statistical software have made modern techniques for handling missing data more accessible and easier to implement. However, optimally applying these methods in moderation analysis remains challenging given assumption violations that arise from the nonnormality of interaction term when traditional approaches are used and nuances faced when modeling interaction terms in the presence of item-level missing data that must be reconciled with scale-level analyses. To address these issues, we present a comprehensive and practical user’s guide on implementing an advanced approach, factored regression specification (FRS), that ideally handles missing data in observed-variable-moderation models. Specifically, we provide step-by-step guidance for conducting FRS at both scale and item levels in various interaction scenarios that include missing data with both continuous and categorical variables. We also derive and present a new coding method to address the challenge of probing simple slopes in continuous-variable interactions that contain item-level missingness. Finally, we supply R code to facilitate implementation of the methods described and offer practical recommendations for researchers.
summaryZh: 传统方法下交互项非正态会导致假设违背，使缺失数据处理方法在调节分析中难以最优应用。 项目水平缺失需与量表水平分析协调，是交互项建模中的难点。 作者推导并提出一种新的编码方法，用于在含项目水平缺失的连续变量交互中检验简单斜率。
